inquiry.unconfirmedFailureMessage: We could not confirm whether this inquiry was saved. Check the inquiry history before trying again.

settings.title: Server
settings.serverAddressHint: Leave blank to use the default cloud server. To run fully offline, enter the address shown by the ENGRAM desktop app on your local network, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:3101
settings.invalidAddress: That doesn't look like a valid address.
settings.connected: Connected. This address is now active.
settings.savedNoResponse: Saved — but the server did not respond. Double-check the address and that the desktop app is running.
settings.languageHint: Choose the app's interface language and the language your engrams reply in.
settings.offlineHint: Run the engrams entirely on this phone — no server, no network. Uses a local model ({{model}}, ~{{size}} one-time download) and keeps conversations in on-device storage. Chat, inquiries and transmissions work; media, simulations and the hub need the server.
settings.modelReady: Model ready. You can now go fully offline.
settings.offlineActive: Offline mode active — everything now runs on this device.
settings.syncPending: Back online. Offline history is still safe on this phone and will retry when the server is reachable.
settings.modelImportReady: Custom GGUF imported and ready for offline use.
settings.modelImportFailed: Couldn't import that GGUF model — please choose another file.
settings.importCancelled: GGUF import cancelled. Your previous model is still safe.
settings.storageCheckUnavailable: Available storage could not be checked. Import is blocked until storage can be measured.
settings.storageInsufficient: Not enough free storage. Free at least {{size}} more before importing.

notifications.statusFailed: Registration failed recently. ENGRAM will retry when the app is active.
notifications.permissionDeniedBody: Allow ENGRAM notifications in system settings to know when an engram reaches out.
